theme.premise: a lone frontier mining outpost whose drill-core tower holds out against endless waves of blocky scrap-machines, rebuilding a little stronger after every fall
theme.tone: tense, gritty, deeply satisfying — the steady grind of a base that keeps getting stronger
theme.setting: a scorched rust-and-slate frontier plateau under a dusty dusk sky

concept.core_loop: A central core tower auto-fires at continuous waves (~25s each) of machines that always walk to the center. Kills pay CASH (spent live on temporary in-run levels for any tapped building), XP (a full bar opens a seeded 3-card building DRAFT while time slows to 20% — place a new run-only building in a free slot or +1 an owned type) and COINS (banked at death to permanently place/upgrade buildings and core stats on the persistent 5x5 base between runs). The live decision every pick and every cash spend: the 24 base slots are scarce and each goes to eco OR defense — building eco (Mine, Oil Mill, Bounty Office) gains faster leveling and cash but gives up the firepower to survive the next spike; adjacency (Armory beside weapons, Oil Mill beside Mines) makes placement matter. Difficulty: enemy HP/damage x1.12 per wave, spawn rate ramps to a MAX cap, and every 10th wave is a boss spike that punishes greedy bases.
mechanics: central core tower auto-targeting nearest enemy in range
continuous waves with Drone/Skitter/Hauler enemies and a boss every 10th wave; HP/damage scale per wave, spawn rate capped
fixed 5x5 base grid around the core (24 slots), outer ring locked until bought

8 buildings as stat modifiers: Gun Turret, Mortar (splash), Tesla Coil (chain+slow), Armory (adjacent weapon dmg), Bulwark (HP+regen), Mine (cash/sec), Oil Mill (XP gain, Mine adjacency), Bounty Office (cash per kill)
in-run cash: tap a building to buy temporary levels
XP bar + level-up 3-card building draft with 20% slow-mo
Base screen: permanent placement/upgrade of buildings, slot unlocks, core stat upgrades with coins
persistent save of base layout, levels and coins
core HP, death -> results screen -> base screen -> new run
concept.art_direction: flat blocky top-down primitives on dark slate (#1b2027) with rust-orange accents; category colour-coding — weapons cyan, eco amber, support green, enemies red/magenta squares & triangles, core white with a pulsing ring; background: faint build-grid with drifting dust motes so no dead space; feedback: muzzle flash + hit flash, floating cash pops, screen shake + red vignette on core damage, radial burst on level-up, squash-pop when a building is placed or upgraded
concept.differentiation_notes: The Tower's proven idle-TD loop, but every upgrade — in-run draft, in-run cash and permanent workshop — is a physical building competing for 24 scarce adjacency-sensitive slots, turning stat-button menus into a spatial eco-vs-defense base-building puzzle.

issues: playtest-audit (advisory): balanced campaign plateaus ~wave 30 by run 6 (18,20,28,29,29,30,30,30) — meta curve flattens; revisit costs in a deepen/run-meta pass
playtest-audit (advisory): pure-eco is far weaker (best wave 7) — eco only pays off mixed with weapons, as designed, but eco may feel like a trap to new players
builder (advisory): when all unlocked slots are full and only 2 types are owned, the draft offers 2 cards instead of 3

depth_pass.notes: Built by studio workflow (designer, theorist, PM, 2 engine, art, UI, balance, visual-audit, PM acceptance, fix round). 30-day campaign sim: T2 by day 4, T3 by day 11, best wave climbs 30 -> 55+; eco-mix beats pure weapon. Spec in games/towerdef-0001/design/.
